item.title: Post-Quantum HPKE
item.description: The IETF is working on post-quantum security for HPKE , the scheme used in protocols like TLS ECH, MLS, and Oblivious HTTP. We’ve implemented the draft: it runs today in hpke-rs, part of libcrux , and you can try it live in the demo further down this post. This post covers what changes on the way to post-quantum HPKE, and why the transition may not be a drop-in.
